title: EvoDesign: Agentic Editable Diagram Creation via Design Expertise Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2604.09568v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: High-fidelity diagram creation requires coordinated visual-spatial decisions over semantic topology, visual styling, and geometric layout. Existing methods face a representation gap: pixel-based generation offers limited object-level control, while code-based synthesis provides executable structure at the cost of intuitive manipulation. We introduce EvoDesign, an agentic framework for editable diagram creation through an intermediate canvas schema that is both machine-actionable and directly manipulable by users. EvoDesign first constructs a diagram manifest through coordinated structure, style, and layout agents, and then renders the manifest in a diagnostic verification environment. This environment produces objective defect signals and VLM-based critique, enabling localized refinement of the current diagram while also providing evidence for long-term design expertise evolution. translated_title: EvoDesign：基于设计专长演化的智能体式可编辑图表创作
translated_abstract: 高保真的图表创作需要在语义拓扑、视觉样式和几何布局上进行协调一致的视觉空间决策。现有方法面临表征鸿沟：基于像素的生成方式提供的对象级控制有限，而基于代码的合成方式虽然提供了可执行的结构，却牺牲了直观的操作性。我们提出了EvoDesign，这是一个智能体框架，它通过一种既可被机器操作、又可供用户直接操控的中间画布模式来实现可编辑的图表创作。EvoDesign首先通过结构、样式与布局三个协同工作的智能体构建图表清单，随后在一个诊断验证环境中对该清单进行渲染。该环境能够产生客观的缺陷信号和基于视觉语言模型的批评意见，从而实现对当前图表的局部化精修，同时为长期的设计专长演化提供证据。该演化机制从精修轨迹中提炼出可复用的设计经验。
tldr: EvoDesign提出了一种智能体框架，通过机器可操作且用户可编辑的中间画布模式、结构-样式-布局协同智能体、诊断验证环境以及从精修轨迹中持续积累设计专长的演化机制，实现了高保真的可编辑图表创作。
en_tdlr: EvoDesign is an agentic framework that achieves high-fidelity editable diagram creation via a machine-actionable and user-manipulable canvas schema, coordinated structure/style/layout agents, diagnostic verification, and long-term design expertise evolution distilled from refinement trajectories.
